title: calamintha caroliniana
intro: Calamintha caroliniana, commonly known as Sweet Melissa, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been used for its medicinal and culinary purposes, offering various health benefits, including digestive relief, anti-inflammatory properties, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Calamintha caroliniana include its ability to act as a carminative, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful for treating conditions such as bloating, muscle spasms, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Calamintha caroliniana include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
